description: Return the free opening scene of one public InkQuest story: plain text, pinyin or pronunciation and short glosses when the catalog has them, and the opening choices. Premium choices are labeled and their following scenes are omitted. Always includes the https://inkquest.dev/stories/{id} URL where the reader continues. Refuses unknown ids, withdrawn demos, locked stories, and user-generated stories. Never returns subscriber-only scene text.

story_id.description: Public catalog id from list_stories, such as before-the-rain-stops.

name: get_story_opening
title: Get the free opening
